gloss: to want desperately; to be dying for

definitions.explanation: Extreme desire for something just out of reach; literally 'a hand comes out of the throat' to grab it. Almost always in the form {喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど{欲|ほ}しい, 'want it so much that a hand comes out of one's throat.'

examples.japanese: {喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want it so badly I can hardly stand it.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど⟦{欲|ほ}しかった→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{高|たか}すぎて⟦{買|か}えなかった→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I wanted that watch desperately, but it was too expensive to buy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど{欲|ほ}しがって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Skilled engineers are the kind of people every company is desperate to get.

notes:
Literally 'a hand comes out of the throat': the wanting is so strong that a hand reaches out from inside to grab the thing. Almost always with ほど and ⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧: to want desperately
- {喉|のど}から{手|て}が{出|で}るほど{欲|ほ}し⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: (someone) is desperate to get

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{欲|ほ}しくて→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧たまらない: to want unbearably — a plain intensifier, without the image
- ⟦{目|め}がない→目がない：30820_meganai⟧: to have a weakness for — a standing fondness rather than an acute craving
